title: Blood Toucheth Blood
body:
IUIC in the ClassRoom · 2026-10-03

Opens [Hos 4](/bible/hosea/4) · [2 Kgs 15](/bible/2-kings/15) · [2 Kgs 10](/bible/2-kings/10) · [2 Kgs 8](/bible/2-kings/8) · [Hos 13](/bible/hosea/13) · [Eccl 1](/bible/ecclesiastes/1) · [Rom 15](/bible/romans/15) · [Gen 4](/bible/genesis/4) · [Judg 9](/bible/judges/9) · [Mic 7](/bible/micah/7) · [Hos 6](/bible/hosea/6) · [Wis 14](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/14) · [2 Macc 4](/bible/2-maccabees/4) · [John 14](/bible/john/14) · [1 Cor 15](/bible/1-corinthians/15) · [Prov 1](/bible/proverbs/1)
## Introduction *[[7:09](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CO-THOc-IhQ&t=429s)]* Blood toucheth blood: the continual, uninterrupted violence our people do to one another. From the assassinations among the kings of the northern kingdom to the knife crime in the streets of the UK today, the same spirit is at work, the Lord has a controversy with us over it, and all of it stems back to idolatry. ## In The News - *[[12:11](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CO-THOc-IhQ&t=731s)]* **Street teaching in Montserrat** — Our people in captivity have no protection: not religion, not politics, not taxes, not war. The only protection is returning to the Lord. - *[[14:20](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CO-THOc-IhQ&t=860s)]* **Footage from the Congo** — What the work looks like on the other side of the world; a documentary is coming. - *[[16:07](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CO-THOc-IhQ&t=967s)]* **The class title video** — From the streets of America to the cities of Europe, blood shed by our own, and all of it spoken of long ago. - *[[19:44](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CO-THOc-IhQ&t=1184s)]* **A stabbing in a chicken shop on Brixton Road** — A seventy-year-old stabbed, two suspects wanted. That is what our society deals with, and not only among the youth. - *[[1:08:30](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CO-THOc-IhQ&t=4110s)]* **Teenagers dancing after a stabbing and shooting at Hackney Central Station** — They lie in wait for blood, they kill, and then they celebrate it; the video on one of their own phones convicted them, and they were jailed for a total of seventy-seven years. - *[[1:11:17](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CO-THOc-IhQ&t=4277s)]* **A machete fight in public** — What is so important that men have to fight like that in the street with blades? - *[[1:13:00](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CO-THOc-IhQ&t=4380s)]* **School children fighting** — This is the UK: knives are ninety per cent of what people carry here. One in the wrong place and it is a fatality, and foolishness starts from young. - *[[1:17:49](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CO-THOc-IhQ&t=4669s)]* **CCTV of a delivery rider attacked for his bike** — That bike is his livelihood, he feeds his family from it. It is not funny; it shows how we lack mercy in all walks of life. ## Scriptures Opened **[Hosea 4:1-2](/bible/hosea/4#v1)** *[[21:51](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CO-THOc-IhQ&t=1311s)]* > [1](/bible/hosea/4#v1) Hear the word of the Lord, ye children of Israel: for the Lord hath a controversy with the inhabitants of the land, because there is no truth, nor mercy, nor knowledge of God in the land. > > [2](/bible/hosea/4#v2) By swearing, and lying, and killing, and stealing, and committing adultery, they break out, and blood toucheth blood. - The Lord has a controversy with the inhabitants of the land: a lawsuit brought against the nation. The charge is what is missing, no truth, no mercy, no knowledge of God in the land. - That is our issue today, and not only among the youth. There are men with grey hairs and beards doing dumb stuff out there; but this generation of young men is the one we have to get a hold of, because some of them are moving really bad. - Swearing, lying, killing, stealing, committing adultery, they break out, and blood toucheth blood. Those are the issues inside our own community. - Blood toucheth blood is continuous, uninterrupted violence. That is what a lot of our people specialise in, and it is not a new thing that sprung up. **[2 Kings 15:8-10](/bible/2-kings/15#v8)** *[[25:25](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CO-THOc-IhQ&t=1525s)]* > [8](/bible/2-kings/15#v8) In the thirty and eighth year of Azariah king of Judah did Zachariah the son of Jeroboam reign over Israel in Samaria six months. > > [9](/bible/2-kings/15#v9) And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, as his fathers had done: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin. > > [10](/bible/2-kings/15#v10) And Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him, and smote him before the people, and slew him, and reigned in his stead. - Zachariah the son of Jeroboam over the northern kingdom in Samaria, six months, and he did what we do best, which is evil. - He departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin. Our own kings made us to sin. - Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him and smote him before the people. That is a public assassination, a public execution, and then he reigned in his stead. - Six months in power, then killed publicly. The mindset of our people was the same back then as the mindset in the street video played at the top of the class. **[2 Kings 10:28-30](/bible/2-kings/10#v28)** *[[27:15](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CO-THOc-IhQ&t=1635s)]* > [28](/bible/2-kings/10#v28) Thus Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel. > > [29](/bible/2-kings/10#v29) Howbeit from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, Jehu departed not from after them, to wit, the golden calves that were in Beth–el, and that were in Dan. > > [30](/bible/2-kings/10#v30) And the Lord said unto Jehu, Because thou hast done well in executing that which is right in mine eyes, and hast done unto the house of Ahab according to all that was in mine heart, thy children of the fourth generation shall sit on the throne of Israel. - Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel, but he would not depart from the golden calves that were in Bethel and in Dan. He did what was right in one thing and kept the sin in another. - Because he did well in executing what was right in the Lord's eyes against the house of Ahab, his children of the fourth generation would sit on the throne of Israel. - Count the four on the chart: Jehoahaz, Joash, Jeroboam the second, and Zachariah. Then Shallum came and executed him. The prophecy came to pass to the fourth generation and that was the end of the dynasty. **[2 Kings 15:13-16](/bible/2-kings/15#v13)** *[[29:53](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CO-THOc-IhQ&t=1793s)]* > [13](/bible/2-kings/15#v13) Shallum the son of Jabesh began to reign in the nine and thirtieth year of Uzziah king of Judah; and he reigned a full month in Samaria. > > [14](/bible/2-kings/15#v14) For Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah, and came to Samaria, and smote Shallum the son of Jabesh in Samaria, and slew him, and reigned in his stead. > > [15](/bible/2-kings/15#v15) And the rest of the acts of Shallum, and his conspiracy which he made, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel. > > [16](/bible/2-kings/15#v16) Then Menahem smote Tiphsah, and all that were therein, and the coasts thereof from Tirzah: because they opened not to him, therefore he smote it; and all the women therein that were with child he ripped up. - Shallum reigned a full month in Samaria, thirty days. Judah was on point at this time; the northern kingdom were going off. - Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah, came to Samaria, smote Shallum and reigned in his stead. Being king did not guarantee your life; your life was marked. - Tiphsah would not open to him, because a lot of them still had an allegiance to Shallum. You have come and taken him out and now you want us to take you as king? They said no, so he smote the city. - All the women therein that were with child he ripped up. You talk about hatred for your own people: that is how evil he was, and how much more evil can you get than that? - Six months you have a king, then one month you have a king. Imagine the chaos in a nation that unstable, where the people did not know who their king was. That is the continuous uninterrupted violence Hosea was prophesying about. **[2 Kings 8:12](/bible/2-kings/8#v12)** *[[35:17](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CO-THOc-IhQ&t=2117s)]* > [12](/bible/2-kings/8#v12) And Hazael said, Why weepeth my lord? And he answered, Because I know the evil that thou wilt do unto the children of Israel: their strong holds wilt thou set on fire, and their young men wilt thou slay with the sword, and wilt dash their children, and rip up their women with child. - Hazael was appointed king of Syria, and the evil he would do unto the children of Israel was told to him beforehand: their strongholds set on fire, their young men slain with the sword, their children dashed and their women with child ripped up. - Ripping babies out of the bellies of women was their trademark; they had a history of doing it. - That is what our forefathers adopted and turned on their own people. How evil were we? We were worse than the damn heathen. **[Hosea 13:16](/bible/hosea/13#v16)** *[[37:17](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CO-THOc-IhQ&t=2237s)]* > [16](/bible/hosea/13#v16) Samaria shall become desolate; for she hath rebelled against her God: they shall fall by the sword: their infants shall be dashed in pieces, and their women with child shall be ripped up. - Samaria shall become desolate because she hath rebelled against her God. That is idolatry, and this prophecy is Syria invading Israel. - Their infants dashed in pieces and their women with child ripped up: the very thing Menahem did to Tiphsah is what these nations did to us. - They have always wanted to wipe out our generations, back to Egypt and on to the time of Christ. Their rise to power coincides with our demise, and in those days we sank lower than the nations around us. **[2 Kings 15:17](/bible/2-kings/15#v17)** *[[39:56](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CO-THOc-IhQ&t=2396s)]* > [17](/bible/2-kings/15#v17) In the nine and thirtieth year of Azariah king of Judah began Menahem the son of Gadi to reign over Israel, and reigned ten years in Samaria. - Menahem the son of Gadi reigned ten years in Samaria, exactly as the chart of the kings has it. - Ten years: a ten-year stint of evil towards our own people, and he got there by taking out Shallum. **[2 Kings 15:23-26](/bible/2-kings/15#v23)** *[[41:02](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CO-THOc-IhQ&t=2462s)]* > [23](/bible/2-kings/15#v23) In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah Pekahiah the son of Menahem began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned two years. > > [24](/bible/2-kings/15#v24) And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin. > > [25](/bible/2-kings/15#v25) But Pekah the son of Remaliah, a captain of his, conspired against him, and smote him in Samaria, in the palace of the king’s house, with Argob and Arieh, and with him fifty men of the Gileadites: and he killed him, and reigned in his room. > > [26](/bible/2-kings/15#v26) And the rest of the acts of Pekahiah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel. - Pekahiah the son of Menahem reigned two years in Samaria, and he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord. Surprise, surprise, evil again, departing not from the sins of Jeroboam. - Pekah the son of Remaliah, his own captain, conspired against him and smote him in the palace of the king's house with fifty men of the Gileadites, and reigned in his room. - Your own captain, your own people did this to you. Whatever oath of allegiance, whatever loyalty and brotherhood there was, it meant absolutely zero. - The trend continues and continues: political power, military power, whatever you want to call it, we had a lust for it and a desire to shed blood. All this time the people are just confused, watching king after king get assassinated. **[2 Kings 15:27-31](/bible/2-kings/15#v27)** *[[43:47](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CO-THOc-IhQ&t=2627s)]* > [27](/bible/2-kings/15#v27) In the two and fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah Pekah the son of Remaliah began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned twenty years. > > [28](/bible/2-kings/15#v28) And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin. > > [29](/bible/2-kings/15#v29) In the days of Pekah king of Israel came Tiglath–pileser king of Assyria, and took Ijon, and Abel–beth–maachah, and Janoah, and Kedesh, and Hazor, and Gilead, and Galilee, all the land of Naphtali, and carried them captive to Assyria. > > [30](/bible/2-kings/15#v30) And Hoshea the son of Elah made a conspiracy against Pekah the son of Remaliah, and smote him, and slew him, and reigned in his stead, in the twentieth year of Jotham the son of Uzziah. > > [31](/bible/2-kings/15#v31) And the rest of the acts of Pekah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel. - Pekah the son of Remaliah reigned twenty years in Samaria, and he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord. Evil again. - In his days Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria came and carried Ijon, Abel-beth-maachah, Janoah, Kedesh, Hazor, Gilead, Galilee and all the land of Naphtali captive to Assyria. The Lord's prophecy is coming to pass and we are going into the Assyrian captivity. - Hoshea the son of Elah made a conspiracy against Pekah, smote him, slew him and reigned in his stead. The trend is still running right up to the captivity. - Hoshea was the last king before the Assyrian captivity; jump two chapters on to chapter 17 and you read the captivity itself. You can see the trend of how our forefathers the kings were towards one another, that lust for power. **[Ecclesiastes 1:9](/bible/ecclesiastes/1#v9)** *[[49:02](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CO-THOc-IhQ&t=2942s)]* > [9](/bible/ecclesiastes/1#v9) The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be; and that which is done is that which shall be done: and there is no new thing under the sun. - The thing that hath been is that which shall be: the things we just read about our forefathers are the things that shall be, because the same spirits are back doing the same thing. - Colombia ran the same way: Rodrigo Lara Bonilla killed in 1984 and another assassinated two years later, in the days when the cocaine was coming out of Colombia into the States. - The continent of Africa is the same, power struggle and assassination upon assassination. Dozens of attempts on one leader's life, and his closest man offered five million to take him out. The average negro would take that money. - There is no new thing under the sun, and that is why the prophets are back again teaching Israel: thus saith the Lord, keep my commandments and live. Our job is to wake up the twelve tribes and let them know, thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart. Then we will not have to be burying one another like this. **[Romans 15:4](/bible/romans/15#v4)** *[[51:05](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CO-THOc-IhQ&t=3065s)]* > [4](/bible/romans/15#v4) For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope. - Whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning. That is why we need to study, and why we go back into the history. - Them spirits there are the same spirits we deal with today, and them issues there are the same issues. The killings, the lust for power, the lust for money, they all exist now. - Do not tell yourself those were the olden days, Bible days, and we are good now because of the year on the calendar. It is the same today as it was back then. **[Hosea 4:3](/bible/hosea/4#v3)** *[[52:35](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CO-THOc-IhQ&t=3155s)]* > [3](/bible/hosea/4#v3) Therefore shall the land mourn, and every one that dwelleth therein shall languish, with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven; yea, the fishes of the sea also shall be taken away. - Therefore shall the land mourn. The land mourns because of how we deal with each other, the killings and the hatred and the preeminence and all these evil spirits we have towards one another. - Everyone that dwelleth therein shall languish. That is why we languish: our spirits are off, we are lost, we do not know who we are. - The beasts of the field, the fowls of heaven and the fishes of the sea are taken away with us. The repercussions run past the people and into the land itself. Precepts: - **[Jeremiah 17:4](/bible/jeremiah/17#v4)** > [4](/bible/jeremiah/17#v4) And thou, even thyself, shalt discontinue from thine heritage that I gave thee; and I will cause thee to serve thine enemies in the land which thou knowest not: for ye have kindled a fire in mine anger, which shall burn for ever. Thou shalt discontinue from thine heritage that I gave thee, and I will cause thee to serve thine enemies in the land which thou knowest not. That is the lawsuit the Lord took out against the nation: you serve your enemies, you forget who you are, and you walk around blind. **[Genesis 4:10](/bible/genesis/4#v10)** *[[55:02](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CO-THOc-IhQ&t=3302s)]* > [10](/bible/genesis/4#v10) And he said, What hast thou done? the voice of thy brother’s blood crieth unto me from the ground. - The voice of thy brother's blood crieth unto me from the ground. When we go around doing wickedness and killing each other, our blood cries to the Lord. - It does not go unchecked or unnoticed. Not one of the assassinations read about in 2 Kings 15 went unnoticed, and neither does what our brothers and sisters do today. Precepts: - **[Numbers 35:33](/bible/numbers/35#v33)** > [33](/bible/numbers/35#v33) So ye shall not pollute the land wherein ye are: for blood it defileth the land: and the land cannot be cleansed of the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it. Blood defileth the land, and the land cannot be cleansed of the blood that is shed therein but by the blood of him that shed it. Be careful when you are out plotting against your brother or your sister: that cannot be cleansed. **[Judges 9:1-5](/bible/judges/9#v1)** *[[56:49](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CO-THOc-IhQ&t=3409s)]* > [1](/bible/judges/9#v1) And Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem unto his mother’s brethren, and communed with them, and with all the family of the house of his mother’s father, saying, > > [2](/bible/judges/9#v2) Speak, I pray you, in the ears of all the men of Shechem, Whether is better for you, either that all the sons of Jerubbaal, which are threescore and ten persons, reign over you, or that one reign over you? remember also that I am your bone and your flesh. > > [3](/bible/judges/9#v3) And his mother’s brethren spake of him in the ears of all the men of Shechem all these words: and their hearts inclined to follow Abimelech; for they said, He is our brother. > > [4](/bible/judges/9#v4) And they gave him threescore and ten pieces of silver out of the house of Baal–berith, wherewith Abimelech hired vain and light persons, which followed him. > > [5](/bible/judges/9#v5) And he went unto his father’s house at Ophrah, and slew his brethren the sons of Jerubbaal, being threescore and ten persons, upon one stone: notwithstanding yet Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left; for he hid himself. - Abimelech went to his mother's brethren in Shechem and put it to them: whether is better, that all the sons of Jerubbaal, threescore and ten persons, reign over you, or that one reign over you? Remember also that I am your bone and your flesh. - Their hearts inclined to follow him, for they said, he is our brother. That was the whole of their reasoning. - With threescore and ten pieces of silver out of the house of Baalberith he hired vain and light persons to follow him. A man with that lust for power, money or preeminence always picks dumb people to put around him; he does not want anybody intelligent who is going to pick up on his nonsense and give him a bigger problem. He wants yes men. - He went to his father's house at Ophrah and slew his brethren, threescore and ten persons, upon one stone. To kill seventy of your own brothers, you know how evil and how lustful for power you have to be. - Only Jotham the youngest was left, for he hid himself. The Lord preserved one of them for a purpose. **[Judges 9:22-25](/bible/judges/9#v22)** *[[1:02:28](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CO-THOc-IhQ&t=3748s)]* > [22](/bible/judges/9#v22) When Abimelech had reigned three years over Israel, > > [23](/bible/judges/9#v23) Then God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech: > > [24](/bible/judges/9#v24) That the cruelty done to the threescore and ten sons of Jerubbaal might come, and their blood be laid upon Abimelech their brother, which slew them; and upon the men of Shechem, which aided him in the killing of his brethren. > > [25](/bible/judges/9#v25) And the men of Shechem set liers in wait for him in the top of the mountains, and they robbed all that came along that way by them: and it was told Abimelech. - Abimelech reigned three years over Israel, and then God sent an evil spirit between him and the men of Shechem, and they dealt treacherously with him. The Lord flipped the switch on them. - That is the warning: choose your friends carefully. When you pair up with somebody in evil, talking about brothers, sisters and leadership, and everything is good between you, you are marking yourself; the Lord will have you at each other's throats down the line. - The cruelty done to the threescore and ten sons of Jerubbaal was laid upon Abimelech their brother, and upon the men of Shechem which aided him in the killing of his brethren. Guilty by association and by action: the blood cried, and the Lord put it back on them. - The men of Shechem who were on one accord with him now set liers in wait for him in the top of the mountains, and robbed all that came along that way. Precepts: - **[1 Timothy 1:20](/bible/1-timothy/1#v20)** > [20](/bible/1-timothy/1#v20) Of whom is Hymeneus and Alexander; whom I have delivered unto Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme. Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I have delivered unto Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme: the Lord delivers people to the devil. If you have that murderous spirit on you, you need to check that spirit, because he can mark you and hand you over. **[Micah 7:1-5](/bible/micah/7#v1)** *[[1:07:19](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CO-THOc-IhQ&t=4039s)]* > [1](/bible/micah/7#v1) Woe is me! for I am as when they have gathered the summer fruits, as the grapegleanings of the vintage: there is no cluster to eat: my soul desired the firstripe fruit. > > [2](/bible/micah/7#v2) The good man is perished out of the earth: and there is none upright among men: they all lie in wait for blood; they hunt every man his brother with a net. > > [3](/bible/micah/7#v3) That they may do evil with both hands earnestly, the prince asketh, and the judge asketh for a reward; and the great man, he uttereth his mischievous desire: so they wrap it up. > > [4](/bible/micah/7#v4) The best of them is as a brier: the most upright is sharper than a thorn hedge: the day of thy watchmen and thy visitation cometh; now shall be their perplexity. > > [5](/bible/micah/7#v5) Trust ye not in a friend, put ye not confidence in a guide: keep the doors of thy mouth from her that lieth in thy bosom. - The good man is perished out of the earth and there is none upright among men. They all lie in wait for blood; they hunt every man his brother with a net. That is the spirit in our community, read in 2 Kings 15 and applying today. - We are predators towards each other. We hunt each other and we are always trying to ambush each other. That is how we are. - They do evil with both hands earnestly, and it runs from the top down: the prince asketh, the judge asketh for a reward, and the great man uttereth his mischievous desire, so they wrap it up. - Trust ye not in a friend, put ye not confidence in a guide. Prove your friends carefully, and teach your children to prove theirs, because foolishness starts from young. **[Hosea 6:1-8](/bible/hosea/6#v1)** *[[1:14:56](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CO-THOc-IhQ&t=4496s)]* > [1](/bible/hosea/6#v1) Come, and let us return unto the Lord: for he hath torn, and he will heal us; he hath smitten, and he will bind us up. > > [2](/bible/hosea/6#v2) After two days will he revive us: in the third day he will raise us up, and we shall live in his sight. > > [3](/bible/hosea/6#v3) Then shall we know, if we follow on to know the Lord: his going forth is prepared as the morning; and he shall come unto us as the rain, as the latter and former rain unto the earth. > > [4](/bible/hosea/6#v4) O Ephraim, what shall I do unto thee? O Judah, what shall I do unto thee? for your goodness is as a morning cloud, and as the early dew it goeth away. > > [5](/bible/hosea/6#v5) Therefore have I hewed them by the prophets; I have slain them by the words of my mouth: and thy judgments are as the light that goeth forth. > > [6](/bible/hosea/6#v6) For I desired mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings. > > [7](/bible/hosea/6#v7) But they like men have transgressed the covenant: there have they dealt treacherously against me. > > [8](/bible/hosea/6#v8) Gilead is a city of them that work iniquity, and is polluted with blood. - Come and let us return unto the Lord, for he hath torn and he will heal us, he hath smitten and he will bind us up. That is what we need to do as a people. - He has smitten us, and our punishment has been a harsh punishment. From when he sent our enemies against us, from when they landed where we were until today, what we see of the atrocities is only a snippet of what happened to us. - Your goodness is as a morning cloud and as the early dew it goeth away; therefore have I hewed them by the prophets and slain them by the words of my mouth. The prophets have always warned our people what to do and what not to do. - For I desired mercy and not sacrifice, and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings. It was never about sacrifice; he wanted us to deal right by one another and keep the commandments rather than bring animals to burn. - Mercy is the very thing Hosea 4 says we lack, and the Lord has shown it to us: he had every right to wipe us out as a nation and he did not. - But they like men have transgressed the covenant, there have they dealt treacherously against me.
